40019940.author: पदार्थः
40019940.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, अगस्त्येरितं spoken by Agastya, वाक्यं statement, रामः Rama, विस्मयमागतः became astonished, कथं how, आसीत् was, तु indeed, लङ्कायां in Lanka, सम्भवः origin, रक्षसां of Rakshasas, पुरा formerly.

40019940.author: Translation
40019940.content: Having heard the words spoken by Agastya, Rama was filled with astonishment, wondering how the Rakshasas could have originated in Lanka in ancient times.

40019941.author: पदार्थः
40019941.content: ततः then, शिरः head, कम्पयित्वा having shaken, त्रेताग्निसमविग्रहम् whose body was like the three sacred fires, तम् him, अगस्त्यं Agastya, मुहुः repeatedly, दृष्ट्वा having seen, स्मयमानः smiling, अभ्यभाषत spoke to.

40019941.author: Translation
40019941.content: Then, shaking his head and repeatedly looking at Agastya, whose body resembled the three sacred fires, Rama smiled and spoke to him.

40019942.author: पदार्थः
40019942.content: भगवन् O revered one, पूर्वम् formerly, अपि even, एषा this, लङ्का Lanka, आसीत् was, पिशिताशिनाम् of flesh-eaters, श्रुत्वा having heard, इदं this, भगवद्वाक्यं your revered statement, जातः arisen, मे my, विस्मयः astonishment, परः great.

40019942.author: Translation
40019942.content: O revered one, having heard your statement that this Lanka formerly belonged to the flesh-eaters, a great astonishment has arisen within me.

40019943.author: पदार्थः
40019943.content: पुलस्त्यवंशात् from Pulastya's lineage, उद्भूताः originated, राक्षसाः Rākṣasas, इति thus, नः by us, श्रुतम् heard, इदानीम् now, अन्यतः from another source, च and, अपि also, सम्भवः origin, कीर्तितः narrated, त्वया by you.

40019943.author: Translation
40019943.content: We have heard that the Rākṣasas originated from Pulastya's lineage, but now you have also spoken of their origin from another source.

40019944.author: पदार्थः
40019944.content: रावणात् than Rāvaṇa, कुम्भकर्णात् than Kumbhakarṇa, च and, प्रहस्तात् than Prahasta, विकटात् than Vikaṭa, अपि even, रावणस्य of Rāvaṇa, च and, पुत्रेभ्यः than the sons, किम् what, नु indeed, ते they, बलवत्तराः more powerful.

40019944.author: Translation
40019944.content: Are these new Rākṣasas indeed more powerful than Rāvaṇa, Kumbhakarṇa, Prahasta, Vikaṭa, and even Rāvaṇa's own sons?

40019945.author: पदार्थः
40019945.content: कः who, एषाम् among them, पूर्वकः the first/ancestor, ब्रह्मन् O Brāhmaṇa, किन्नामा what name, च and, बलोत्कटः exceedingly powerful, अपराधम् offense, च and, कम् what, प्राप्य having committed, विष्णुना by Viṣṇu, द्राविताः driven away/destroyed, कथम् how.

40019945.author: Translation
40019945.content: O Brāhmaṇa, who was their first ancestor, what was his name, and how were these exceedingly powerful beings driven away by Viṣṇu after committing what offense?

40019946.author: पदार्थः
40019946.content: एतत् this, विस्तरतः in detail, सर्वम् all, कथयस्व please narrate, मम to me, अनघ O sinless one, कुतूहलम् curiosity, इदम् this, मह्यम् my, नुद dispel, भानुः the sun, यथा just as, तमः darkness.

40019946.author: Translation
40019946.content: O sinless one, please narrate all of this to me in detail and dispel my great curiosity, just as the sun dispels darkness.

40019947.author: पदार्थः
40019947.content: राघवस्य of Rāghava, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, संस्कारालङ्कृतम् adorned with refinement, शुभम् auspicious/beautiful, ईषत् slightly, विस्मयमानः being surprised, तम् him, अगस्त्यः Agastya, प्राह said, राघवम् to Rāghava.

40019947.author: Translation
40019947.content: Having heard Rāghava's auspicious words, adorned with refinement, Agastya, slightly surprised, spoke to Rāghava.

40019948.author: पदार्थः
40019948.content: प्रजापतिः Prajapati, पुरा formerly, सृष्ट्वा having created, हि indeed, अपः waters, सलिलसम्भवः born from water, तासाम् of those (waters), गोपायने for the protection, सत्त्वान् beings, असृजत् created, पद्मसम्भवः born from a lotus.

40019948.author: Translation
40019948.content: In ancient times, Prajapati Brahma, who was born from water and a lotus, first created the waters and then created various beings for their protection.

40019949.author: पदार्थः
40019949.content: ते those, सत्त्वाः beings, सत्त्वकर्तारम् to the creator of beings, विनीतवत् humbly, उपस्थिताः stood before, किम् what, कुर्मः shall we do, इति thus, भाषन्तः speaking, क्षुत्पिपासाभयार्दिताः afflicted by hunger, thirst, and fear.

40019949.author: Translation
40019949.content: Those beings, afflicted by hunger, thirst, and fear, humbly approached their creator and asked, "What shall we do?"

40019950.author: पदार्थः
40019950.content: प्रजापतिः Prajapati, तु indeed, तान् to them, आह said, सत्त्वानि to the beings, प्रहसन् as if laughing, इव as it were, आभाष्य having addressed, वाचा with words, यत्नेन with effort, रक्षध्वम् protect, इति thus, मानदः the giver of honor.

40019950.author: Translation
40019950.content: Prajapati, the giver of honor, addressed those beings as if with a smile and instructed them with effort, "Protect!"

40019951.author: पदार्थः
40019951.content: रक्षाम we will protect, इति thus, च and, तत्र among them, अन्ये others, जक्षाम we will eat, इति thus, च and, अपरे others, भुक्षिताभुक्षितैः by those who desired to eat and those who did not desire to eat, उक्तः having been spoken to, ततः then, तान् to them, आह said, भूतकृत् the creator of beings.

40019951.author: Translation
40019951.content: Among those beings, some said, "We will protect," while others said, "We will eat"; then, having heard these responses from the hungry and the non-hungry, the creator of beings spoke to them.

40019952.author: पदार्थः
40019952.content: रक्षाम we will protect, इति thus, च and, यैः by whom, उक्तम् was said, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, ते those, भवन्तु let them be, वः you. जक्षाम we will eat, इति thus, यैः by whom, उक्तम् was said, यक्षाः Yakshas, एव indeed, भवन्तु let them be, वः you.

40019952.author: Translation
40019952.content: To those who said, "We will protect," he declared, "You shall be Rakshasas," and to those who said, "We will eat," he declared, "You shall indeed be Yakshas."

40019953.author: पदार्थः
40019953.content: तत्र there, हेतिः Heti, प्रहेतिः Praheti, च and, भ्रातरौ two brothers, राक्षसाधिपौ lords of Rākṣasas, मधुकैटभसङ्काशौ resembling Madhu and Kaiṭabha, बभूवतुः existed, अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies.

40019953.author: Translation
40019953.content: There existed two demon lords, Heti and Praheti, who were brothers, vanquishers of foes, and resembled Madhu and Kaiṭabha.

40019954.author: पदार्थः
40019954.content: प्रहेतिः Praheti, धार्मिकः righteous, तत्र there, तपोवनगतः gone to a hermitage, तदा then, हेतिः Heti, दारक्रियार्थे for the purpose of marriage, तु but, परम् great, यत्नम् effort, अथ then, अकरोत् made.

40019954.author: Translation
40019954.content: At that time, Praheti, being righteous, went to a hermitage, while Heti made a great effort to find a wife.

40019955.author: पदार्थः
40019955.content: सः he, कालभगिनीम् sister of Kala, कन्याम् maiden, भयाम् Bhaya, नाम named, भयावहाम् terrifying, उदावहत married, अमेयात्मा of immeasurable spirit, स्वयम् himself, एव indeed, महामतिः great-minded.

40019955.author: Translation
40019955.content: That great-minded Heti, of immeasurable spirit, himself married a terrifying maiden named Bhaya, who was the sister of Kala (Death).

40019956.author: पदार्थः
40019956.content: सः he, तस्याम् in her, जनयामास begot, हेती Heti, राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost among Rākṣasas, पुत्रम् a son, पुत्रवताम् among those who have sons, श्रेष्ठः best, विद्युत्केशः Vidyutkeśa, इति thus, श्रुतम् known.

40019956.author: Translation
40019956.content: Heti, the foremost among Rākṣasas and best among those with sons, begot a son named Vidyutkeśa in her (Bhaya).

40019957.author: पदार्थः
40019957.content: विद्युत्केशः Vidyutkeśa, हेतिपुत्रः Heti's son, सः he, दीप्तार्कसमप्रभः having a brilliance equal to the blazing sun, व्यवर्धत grew, महातेजाः of great splendor, तोयमध्ये in the midst of water, इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud.

40019957.author: Translation
40019957.content: Vidyutkeśa, Heti's son, of great splendor and brilliance like the blazing sun, grew like a cloud in the midst of water.

40019958.author: पदार्थः
40019958.content: सः he, यदा when, यौवनम् youth, भद्रम् auspicious, अनुप्राप्तः attained, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, ततः then, दारक्रियाम् marriage ceremony, तस्य his, कर्तुम् to perform, व्यवसितः resolved, पिता father.

40019958.author: Translation
40019958.content: When the night-wanderer (Vidhyutkesha) attained auspicious youth, his father then resolved to perform his marriage ceremony.

40019959.author: पदार्थः
40019959.content: सन्ध्यायाः of Sandhya, तनयाम् daughter, सः he, अथ then, सन्ध्यातुल्याम् equal to Sandhya, प्रभावतः in splendor, वरयामास sought as a bride, पुत्रार्थम् for his son, हेती Heti, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the chief of Rakshasas.

40019959.author: Translation
40019959.content: Then Heti, the chief of Rakshasas, sought Sandhya's daughter, who was equal to Sandhya in splendor, as a bride for his son.

40019960.author: पदार्थः
40019960.content: अवश्यम् certainly, एव indeed, दातव्या to be given, परस्मै to another, सा she, इति thus, सन्ध्यया by Sandhya, चिन्तयित्वा having thought, सुता the daughter, दत्ता was given, विद्युत्केशाय to Vidhyutkesha, राघव O Rama.

40019960.author: Translation
40019960.content: O Rama, Sandhya, having thought that her daughter must certainly be given to another, thus gave her daughter to Vidhyutkesha.

40019961.author: पदार्थः
40019961.content: सन्ध्यायाः of Sandhya, तनयाम् daughter, लब्ध्वा having obtained, विद्युत्केशः Vidhyutkesha, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, रमते स्म enjoyed, तया with her, सार्धम् together, पौलोम्या with Paulomi, मघवानिव like Maghavan.

40019961.author: Translation
40019961.content: Having obtained Sandhya's daughter, the night-wanderer Vidhyutkesha enjoyed with her, just as Maghavan (Indra) enjoys with Paulomi.

40019962.author: पदार्थः
40019962.content: केनचित् by some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालेन by time, राम O Rama, सालकटङ्कटा Salakatankata, विद्युत्केशात् from Vidhyutkesha, गर्भम् conception, आप obtained, घनराजिः a line of clouds, इव like, अर्णवात् from the ocean.

40019962.author: Translation
40019962.content: O Rama, after some time, Salakatankata conceived from Vidhyutkesha, just as a line of clouds obtains moisture from the ocean.

40019963.author: पदार्थः
40019963.content: ततः then, सा that, राक्षसी female demon, गर्भं offspring, घनगर्भसमप्रभम् having the luster like a thundercloud, प्रसूता gave birth, मन्दरं to Mandara mountain, गत्वा having gone, गङ्गा Ganga, गर्भमिव like an embryo, अग्निजम् born of fire.

40019963.author: Translation
40019963.content: Then, that female demon, having gone to the Mandara mountain, gave birth to an offspring shining like a thundercloud, just as Ganga gave birth to the fire-born embryo (Kartikeya).

40019964.author: पदार्थः
40019964.content: समुत्सृज्य having abandoned, तु indeed, सा she, गर्भं the offspring, विद्युत्केशरतार्थिनी desiring union with Vidyutkesha, रेमे enjoyed, तु indeed, सार्धं with, पतिना her husband, विस्मृत्य having forgotten, सुतम् the son, आत्मजम् her own.

40019964.author: Translation
40019964.content: Having abandoned her offspring, she, desiring union with Vidyutkesha, then enjoyed herself with her husband, completely forgetting her own son.

40019965.author: पदार्थः
40019965.content: उत्सृष्टस्तु but abandoned, तदा then, गर्भो the offspring, घनशब्दसमस्वनः having a sound like the roar of a cloud, तयोत्सृष्टः abandoned by her, स that, तु indeed, शिशुः child, शरदर्कसमद्युतिः having the luster like the autumn sun, निधायास्ये having placed in his mouth, स्वयं himself, मुष्टिं a fist, रुरोद cried, शनकैस्तदा slowly then.

40019965.author: Translation
40019965.content: The abandoned offspring, who had a roar like thunder and a luster like the autumn sun, then cried slowly, having placed his own fist in his mouth.

40019966.author: पदार्थः
40019966.content: ततो then, वृषभम् a bull, आस्थाय having mounted, पार्वत्या with Parvati, सहितः accompanied, शिवः Shiva, वायुमार्गेण through the sky-path, गच्छन्वै indeed going, शुश्राव heard, रुदितस्वनम् the sound of crying.

40019966.author: Translation
40019966.content: Then Shiva, accompanied by Parvati and mounted on a bull, was traveling through the sky and heard the sound of crying.

40019967.author: पदार्थः
40019967.content: अपश्यत् he saw, उमया with Uma, सार्धं together, रुदन्तं crying, राक्षसात्मजम् the demon's son, कारुण्यभावात् due to the feeling of compassion, पार्वत्या of Parvati, भवः Shiva, त्रिपुरसूदनः the destroyer of Tripura.

40019967.author: Translation
40019967.content: Shiva, the destroyer of Tripura, then saw the demon's son crying, accompanied by Uma, moved by Parvati's feeling of compassion.

40019968.author: पदार्थः
40019968.content: तं him, राक्षसात्मजं the son of the demon, चक्रे made, मातुरेव of his mother only, वयःसमम् equal in age, अमरं immortal, चैव and indeed, तं him, कृत्वा having made, महादेवो Lord Mahadeva, अक्षरो imperishable, अव्ययः immutable.

40019968.author: Translation
40019968.content: The imperishable and immutable Lord Mahadeva made that son of the demon, Sukesha, immortal and equal in age to his mother.

40019969.author: पदार्थः
40019969.content: पुरम् a city, आकाशगं moving in the sky, प्रादात् gave, पार्वत्याः of Parvati, प्रियकाम्यया with the desire to please, उमयापि by Uma also, वरो a boon, दत्तो given, राक्षसानां to the demons, नृपात्मज O son of the king.

40019969.author: Translation
40019969.content: To please Parvati, Shiva gave him a city that could move in the sky, and O son of the king, Uma also granted a boon to the demons.

40019970.author: पदार्थः
40019970.content: सद्योपलब्धिः immediate conception, गर्भस्य of the embryo, प्रसूतिः birth, सद्य immediately, एव indeed, च and, सद्य immediately, एव indeed, वयःप्राप्तिः attainment of age, मातुरेव of the mother only, वयस्समम् equal in age.

40019970.author: Translation
40019970.content: The boon granted by Uma was that conception would be immediate, birth would be immediate, and the child would immediately attain an age equal to that of its mother.

40019971.author: पदार्थः
40019971.content: ततः then, सुकेशो Sukesha, वरदानगर्वितः proud of the boon, श्रियं glory, प्रभोः of the lord, प्राप्य having obtained, हरस्य of Shiva, पार्श्वतः from the presence, चचार roamed, सर्वत्र everywhere, महान् great, महामतिः of great intellect, खगं moving in the sky, पुरं city, प्राप्य having obtained, पुरन्दरो Indra, यथा just as.

40019971.author: Translation
40019971.content: Then, Sukesha, proud of the boon and having obtained glory from the presence of Lord Shiva, roamed everywhere, great and of great intellect, just as Indra does after obtaining his celestial city. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्थः सर्गः ।। 4 ।। Thus ends the fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
